sources.measure.speechLineFracOfMax: Speech is RMS above 0.1 x the file's max RMS. Same definition as the katsu-04 cause note and the field lip-sync scorer.
sources.measure.minHoleSec: Shortest silence counted as a hole; the katsu-04 cause note listed holes from 0.15 s. Also the timing tolerance for caption show, hide, and the bed entry, since a shift shorter than a counted hole sits inside one breath.
sources.measure.envelopeWindowSec: Centered RMS window. Definition, not a pass line.
sources.measure.valleyDepthFrac: A dip inside one speech run counts as a phrase onset when it falls to this fraction of the smaller neighbouring peak. Definition, not calibrated.
sources.measure.bedFloorDbfs: A pause louder than this (RMS re full scale) carries a music bed. Definition, not calibrated.
sources.measure.captionColorTol: Max per-channel distance from the layer colour that counts as caption core. 45 makes white start at 210, the threshold of the katsu-05 export check; the katsu-04 note used 220.
sources.measure.plateMinFrac: Side of the square opening, as a fraction of frame height, that keeps a solid light block (a box or pill plate, a light ground) and drops glyph strokes. A 900-weight glyph stroke is about 0.16 em, under 0.025 for cards up to 0.08 cap height; a one-line plate at 0.03 cap height is about 0.05 tall. Definition, not calibrated.
sources.measure.hardCutHsvDelta: Mean HSV frame difference that counts as a hard cut. PySceneDetect ContentDetector default, also used by the field prep script.
sources.measure.faceScoreMin: YuNet detection score, as in the field face script.
sources.tolerance: Measurement tolerances, not calibrated on several cuts. Change one only with measurements from more than one file and write the reason here.
sources.lines.headlineCapHeightFloor: Principle leaf sasaru-principle-captions-read-as-headlines: a headline layer under 0.04 must be raised.
sources.lines.mouth: Optional, only for a cut made on a talkingHead route. The field pre-post gate: correlation 0.30 or more, absolute lag 100 ms or less, mouth more open in speech than in pauses. A lag at the search edge is not trusted.
